input.pdfNote: Transcribed from the PDF. Open the PDF to compare, fix anything that differs, then press "Read it".
input.tooLong: The text is too long ({{count}} characters; up to {{max}}). Delete what isn't needed, then press "Read it".
input.photoNote: Transcribed from the photo. Compare it with the photo, fix anything that differs, then press "Read it".

photoStatus.empty: No text could be read. Retake the photo in good light with the whole notice in frame.
photoStatus.tooLarge: Too large or too many pages (one photo, or a PDF of a few pages up to 4 MB). Keep only the pages you need.

photoStatus.unreadable: The file couldn't be read. Save it to your device, then choose it again.

input.clockTrial: Words like “tomorrow” are read against the current time ({{now}}).
input.privacyFictional: Use fictional text only. Your text, this demo’s recorded items (including family statements), and open questions go to Anthropic’s Claude API. Text is kept in server memory; demos unused for over 12 hours are periodically deleted.
input.photoPrivacyFictional: Use fictional photos and PDFs only. As soon as you choose one, it is sent to Anthropic’s Claude API to check its size and transcribe it. The app does not keep photos.

say.label: Quick update
say.tooLong: The text is too long ({{count}} characters; up to {{max}}). Delete what isn't needed, then press "Send".
say.privacy: Your update, this demo's (fictional) family and helper names, and the current items, tasks and requests (including the people and places involved) are sent to Anthropic. Don't include anything that identifies a person or place (names, school names, addresses).
say.privacySummary: Your update, the names of family and helpers, and current plans and requests are sent to Anthropic. Leave out words that identify people or places.
say.privacySummaryTrial: This is a trial household. Use made-up text only. Your update, the names of family and helpers, and current plans and requests are sent to Anthropic.
say.which: Which one do you mean? The one you tap is recorded.
say.whichUnknown: We could not tell which one. Add the date or person and try again.
say.lookAlike: Some matches look the same, so they aren't offered. Please say it again with the date, time, or person.

blocked.otherTasks: There are other tasks, so a quick update doesn't record this (to avoid recording the wrong one). On Today, find the task's card and record it there.
blocked.otherRequests: There are other requests, so a quick update doesn't record this (to avoid recording the wrong one). On Today, find the request's card and record it there.
blocked.otherUnknowns: There are other questions this could answer, so a quick update doesn't record this answer (to avoid answering the wrong one). If there's a question card on Today, answer there.
blocked.needOnCard: In a trial household, replies to requests for a to-do, and telling someone such a request is cancelled, aren't recorded by a quick update (to avoid recording the wrong one). On Today, check what you sent on the request card and record it there.
blocked.missing: What this refers to isn't in the current plan. Please say it again.

say.unknownRequest: a request whose content is unknown
say.otherAdult: This looks like another adult's task. That person records changes such as not being able to do it or having done it.
say.unowned: One of these tasks has no one assigned yet. Choose who does it on the Today card first.

unsupported.routineChange: Ongoing changes, changes for several people or days, pick-up-only changes and working from home can't be taken from a message yet. For a single day, say whose day and which day (e.g. “What if I take 12/7 off?”).
unsupported.otherAdultsTask: This looks like another adult's task. That person records it.
unsupported.notInPlan: Nothing in the plan matches this.
unsupported.replyOrWhatIf: We couldn’t tell whether this is a real reply or a what-if. Say them separately, such as “Grandma says it’s fine” for a reply or “What if Grandma says no?” for a what-if.
unsupported.other: This update can't be recorded yet.

clock.label: Until each choice disappears
clock.none: No choice is left before its decision deadline

clock.unknownOnly_other: No option with a known deadline is left. {{count}} options have an unknown deadline
clock.show: See the time left for each option

household.title: Our family
household.intro: This is the family information Maniau calculates with. When you edit it, you can see what would change before you save, using the same calculation.

people.label: People
people.used: Used to decide whom to propose tasks to and whom to notify.
people.escortHelp: For events in notices from lessons and clubs, choose for each child whether an adult takes them there (drop-off) and brings them back (pick-up). Maniau makes drop-off and pick-up tasks around the event only for what you choose (it doesn’t guess at ones that aren’t written). For an event where you already decided for that one time (for example, “not needed this time”), that decision is used instead.
people.escortManyChildren: In a household with two or more children, Maniau can’t yet tell which child a lesson notice is for, so it doesn’t make drop-off/pick-up tasks yet (the rules you choose are kept).
people.escortUnsetNow: Not decided yet. Until you choose, no drop-off/pick-up tasks are made.

week.label: A usual week
week.used: Used to find when tasks can fit, and when the child needs someone to look after them. Only “Home” blocks count as time someone can look after the child (if you work from home and can't, mark it “Work”). Before the first block and after the last block of a day, we count the person as at home.
week.noDay: No plan is registered for this day.

places.label: Places and shops
places.used: Used for stops on the way and whether a shop is open in time.

ways.label: Ways to cover
ways.used: Used for each way's decision time (counted back from its deadline) and for the order we recommend.
ways.unusable: Marked as unusable (it can’t be chosen; to use it again, add it as a new way).

preview.label: What this change would do
preview.stale: The household’s records changed after you opened this screen. Refresh, then look again.
preview.escort: Lessons drop-off/pick-up for {{name}} will be set to “{{rule}}”.
preview.unusable: “{{name}}” will be marked as unusable. It can’t be newly chosen, and even if it’s already chosen it isn’t called secured. Requests you already sent aren’t withdrawn; a card asks whether they’re still needed. To use it again, add it as a new way.

cover.lost: {{name}} will no longer cover {{gaps}} (it can’t be newly chosen, and if it’s already chosen it isn’t called secured).
cover.unsure: {{name}} can no longer be confirmed to cover {{gaps}} (it can’t be newly chosen, and if it’s already chosen it isn’t called secured).
cover.full: {{name}} will cover all of the needed time.

overlap.added: Candidate {{when}} for “{{what}}”: if you record this change, it overlaps {{name}}’s busy time ({{busy}}). Answers stay as they are.
overlap.removed: Candidate {{when}} for “{{what}}”: it no longer overlaps {{name}}’s busy time ({{busy}}).

window.split: {{what}}: from the times on record, the times we can’t confirm an adult to watch are split ({{times}}). The arrangement is for {{main}} only. Please check the other times together.
window.joined: {{what}}: from the times on record, the time we can’t confirm an adult to watch becomes {{main}} only (before: {{before}}).

preview.expires: {{name}} would no longer be possible in time.
preview.deadlineUnknown: {{name}}: its decision time can't be worked out, so we can't tell whether it is still possible in time.
preview.deadlineKnown: Decision time for {{name}} can now be worked out: {{after}}
preview.reopens: {{name}} would be possible in time again.
preview.wayGone: {{name}} would no longer be an option.
preview.unplaced: Task can no longer be given a time: {{what}}
preview.placed: Task can now be given a time: {{what}}
preview.reconfirm: Task to re-confirm with whoever took it: {{what}}
preview.releasedCheck: Dropped from the plan: {{what}} (we'll ask {{name}} to check whether it's still needed)
preview.cancel: A cancellation message to {{to}} is needed.
preview.check: Your request to {{to}} needs checking with them: its time or reason has changed since you asked.
preview.conflict: Ways that would clash with other tasks: {{options}}
preview.unverifiedRoute: The route to a place hasn’t been checked (times are estimates).
preview.rechoose: “{{what}}”: a way it uses changed, so its ways need to be chosen again.

preparation.added: {{name}}: it will need an advance step ({{what}}) not confirmed as done (not recommended).
preparation.changed: {{name}}: the reason for the advance step ({{what}}) changes.
preparation.cleared: {{name}}: the advance step mark ({{what}}) goes away.

unused.added: {{name}}: it will use a place you marked “Don’t use” ({{what}}) (not recommended).

recommend.changed: The recommended option for {{what}} changes from {{before}} to {{after}}.
recommend.gone: {{name}} will no longer be recommended for {{what}}.

refused.householdInvalid: This edit doesn't make valid family information (check the order and overlap of times).
refused.routineGap: Keep each usual day's blocks back to back (each block starting when the previous one ends). Time that isn't written down can't be used to work out when the child needs looking after.
refused.routineDayMissing: An adult's usual day can't be removed here.
refused.routinePlace: A block's kind and place don't match (“Home” must be at home; “Out” and “Pick-up” must be somewhere else).
refused.hoursOvernight: Opening hours past midnight aren't supported yet (set the closing time after the opening time).
refused.membersLocked: Only helpers can be added here (adding or removing adults or children, or changing adult/child, isn’t possible).
refused.placesLocked: Removing a place, changing its type or adding a home isn’t possible here.
refused.careOptionsLocked: The steps or the contact of a way can't be changed here.
refused.unavailable: We couldn't calculate this right now. Please try again in a moment.
refused.wayRemoved: Ways can’t be deleted (stop using the way instead).
refused.wayInvalid: Some of the way’s fields are missing or not valid (check the name, steps, times and costs).
refused.wayRefUnknown: Choose who does it, who to ask and where from the adults, helpers and places you registered.
refused.nameTaken: A person or place with the same name already exists. Use a different name so you can tell them apart (for example, “Grandma Sato”).
refused.routineExceptionMember: Single-day changes can be recorded only for adults.

need.label: To do
need.stated: Your family said this (it is not from a notice).
need.written: This was written in a notice.
need.gapsNote: A time counts as covered only when all of a way’s commitments are in (the other side’s yes, and the family member’s acceptance).
need.placeNote: We have not checked that someone will be at the written place, or the travel time.
need.options: Pick the way to go with

dismiss.label: Mark this as not needed
dismiss.note: If you mark it as not needed, accepted tasks are no longer needed and anyone you asked will need a cancellation message. Check what changes below before deciding.

ways.label: Ways to use
ways.none: Your family has no ways yet. You can add one with “Add a way” below.
ways.note: Choose from the ways your family registered. No tasks are made until you choose.
ways.changed: The details or the ways changed after you chose, so please choose again.
ways.noCover: Nobody covers the time (only steps done beforehand)
ways.stopped: This way has been stopped. You can keep it in this choice (once removed, it can’t be chosen again).

add.title: Add something to do
add.intro: Write what your family said, as it was said. The fields below are what the plan uses. Before saving, you will see what this changes.
add.window: Someone is needed during a time
add.by: Get it done by a deadline
add.byTime: Deadline time (empty: by the end of the day)
add.missing: Fill in what was said, what, and the date (and the start and end, for “someone is needed during a time”).
add.byAnswers: Decide the day from people’s answers (offer candidate days)
add.candidatesNote: Enter 2–8 candidate days and times. People answer, and your family chooses one.
add.hold: Someone must cover the whole time

thing.intro: Just enter what to do, by when, and who does it. The person you choose gets it as a task (even if you choose yourself, you take it on from Today).
thing.example: e.g. Hand in the after-school care form
thing.byTime: Time (if empty, by the end of that day)
thing.missing: Enter what to do and by when.
thing.detailed: If someone is needed at set times, add the details
thing.newWay: Adds the way “{{name}}” to your ways (you can change it in “Our family”).
thing.assumed: Things added here are treated as taking {{min}} minutes during {{where}} time in your usual week (we haven’t checked that this works), and we look for a time before the deadline. If none fits, we say so. For things done at a set place, such as a ward office or a shop, or that take longer, add the details instead.
thing.byAnswers: If the day depends on others’ answers, offer candidate days

fix.title: Fix the reading
fix.intro: Fix the fields the plan uses, looking at the original text. Once saved, it goes into the plan as checked by your family.
fix.shape: Kind: {{shape}} (kept from the reading. If the kind is wrong, remove it with “Misread” on Today, then use “Add something to do”.)
fix.changed: This notice changed after it was shown. Please check it again on Today.
fix.conditionNote: The condition and answers can’t be changed here (they are confirmed as read). If they are wrong, remove the reading with “Misread” on Today.
fix.introPlanned: Edit the fields the plan uses. Before saving, you’ll see what this changes (choosing a way again, checking with anyone you asked, and so on).
fix.shapePlanned: Kind: {{shape}} (can’t be changed. If it’s wrong, mark this as not needed and use “Add something to do”.)
fix.conditionNotePlanned: The condition and answers can’t be changed here. If they are wrong, mark this as not needed and use “Add something to do”.
fix.changedPreview: The plan changed after you looked. Please check what this changes again.
fix.candidateTime: The day and time come from the candidates in “Choosing the day”, so they can’t be changed here. Use “Change the candidate days” on that screen (after someone has asked or accepted, mark this item not needed and add it again).
fix.answersReset_one: The {{count}} answer so far was for the old details and will stop counting (ask again).
fix.answersReset_other: The {{count}} answers so far were for the old details and will stop counting (ask again).
fix.chosenReset: The chosen day will no longer be used (ask again, then choose again).
fix.waysReset: You will need to choose the ways again.

refused.needWindowMissing: Enter the date and the start and end times.
refused.needWindowOvernight: Make the end later than the start on the same day (times across midnight are not supported yet).
refused.needMemberUnknown: Choose who it is for from your family.
refused.needGone: This item is gone or has changed.
refused.wayUnknown: A chosen way is not in your family’s information.
refused.unavailable: Could not work it out right now. Please try again shortly.
refused.other: This could not be saved as it is.
refused.wayInactive: A stopped way can’t be newly chosen.
refused.candidatesNeedWindow: Candidate days work only for the “someone is needed at this time” shape.
refused.candidateDuplicate: Two candidates have the same day and time.
refused.candidateUnknown: The candidates changed. Please reopen this screen.
refused.candidateNeedTimeLocked: For an item with candidate days, the day and time can’t be changed here. Use “Change the candidate days” on the “Choosing the day” screen (after someone has asked or accepted, mark this item not needed and add it again).
refused.candidateChanged: The candidates changed. Please choose again from the current ones.
refused.decisionInUse: Someone has already asked or accepted, so the chosen day and details can’t change. To change them, mark this item not needed and add it again.
refused.thingPast: That date and time has already passed. Change the date or time.
refused.dateWeekdayMismatch: The date does not match the weekday that was read. Check the date and weekday in the original notice.
refused.legacyRequestUnclear: An earlier request is missing its recorded details, so the date cannot be corrected. Check the actual request with the recipient too.
refused.selfWayChanged: The do-it-ourselves way has been changed (it now has someone to ask, a place, a set person or similar), so it can’t be used here. Add the details instead, or change that way in “Our family”.

ways.label: Ways to get things done
ways.used: Your family chooses these for each thing to do. Before saving an addition, edit or stop, we show what the change would do.
ways.stopNote: Once stopped, it can’t be newly chosen. Anything that already uses it keeps its choice, tasks and requests.
ways.stopUsing: Chosen for “{{what}}”. To take it off, choose that item’s ways again.

way.intro: Describe, in your own words, how your family gets this kind of thing done. Leave anything you don’t know as “Not known” (we won’t treat it as zero or as “no deadline”). Before saving, we show what the change would do.
way.name: Name of the way
way.newToAddressAs: How to address them (optional; used in messages, e.g. Mum)
way.wait: Time to allow for a reply
way.waitOnly: Put time spent only waiting for a reply here. A separate step that is only waiting also counts as someone’s working time, so entering it in both places makes the times overlap.
way.waitAfterKept: Leaves {{min}} min before the next step (kept as is; not changed here)
way.waitDropped: With no one to ask, the {{min}} min allowed for a reply is removed too
way.placeHoursNote: If the place has no registered opening hours (or only hours from a map), we don’t check that you can go then, and we don’t suggest this way.
way.segments: When it can be done (which part of the usual day)
way.deadlineNone: No rule (by the item’s own deadline or start)
way.deadlineDays: By a time, some days before
way.deadlineBusinessDays: By a time, some business days before
way.deadlineOnTheDay: By a time on the day
way.cover: Whoever does this step (or the person asked) covers the time
way.coverNote: Only used for things that need someone during a set time.
way.coversNote: For example, care from 8:30 to 17:30. Leave empty if you don’t know (the other person’s “yes” confirms it).
way.costNote: Leave unknown costs as “Not known”. When a way’s cost isn’t known, we don’t suggest one.
way.missing: Some fields are still empty or not chosen: name, what to do in each step, fixed place, by when, when it can be done, minutes, costs (and, when asking someone, who and the time to allow for a reply; for Claude’s ideas, also who does it, whether it covers the time, and the hours covered).
way.coversWhole: The whole time of the to-do (confirmed by their “yes” or the family’s schedule)
way.coversPart: Only part of the time (enter it below)

voice.notSent: The text stays in the box until you press “{{send}}”.
voice.about: “Speak” uses your browser or device’s speech recognition (your voice may be sent to its provider). The app gets only the text.
voice.keyboard: If your keyboard has a microphone, you can speak to type. Check the text, then press “{{send}}” (until you do, this app doesn’t send or record the text).

error.notAllowed: Microphone access isn’t allowed. Allow it in your browser settings, or use the microphone on your keyboard.
error.unavailable: Speech recognition isn’t available here (it may not work in an app added to the home screen). Use the microphone on your keyboard.
error.network: Couldn’t reach speech recognition. Check your connection, or use the microphone on your keyboard.
error.noSpeech: No speech was heard. Press “Speak” and try again.
error.other: Couldn’t recognize speech. Try again, or use the microphone on your keyboard.
